problems.description: Attackers send emails impersonating trusted entities to trick users into submitting their login credentials on fake websites.
risk_reduction: Implement multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all accounts
Deploy advanced email filtering and anti-phishing tools
Conduct regular user training and phishing simulation exercises

problems.description: Highly targeted phishing campaigns aimed at specific individuals or roles within an organization to gain access to sensitive information or systems.
risk_reduction: Use threat intelligence to identify targeted campaigns
Limit information exposure on social media and public profiles
Train employees on recognizing personalized phishing attempts

problems.description: Attackers compromise or spoof executive email accounts to request fraudulent wire transfers or sensitive data from employees.
risk_reduction: Verify unusual requests through secondary communication channels
Enable email authentication protocols like DMARC, DKIM, and SPF
Monitor email account activity for anomalies and unauthorized access
